rows.en: Course we are. This is nothin'. And we got the Gundanium alloy, no sweat.
Yes, we're fine. We got the Gundanium alloy too.
Yeah. We got the Gundanium alloy.
Yeah. We got the Gundanium alloy.
Yeah. We got the Gundanium alloy.
Yes, we're fine. We got the Gundanium alloy too.
You bet! And the Gundanium alloy's right here!
...A... a Gundam got us... That was... Team Trinity...
The Maganac Corps... has been wiped out... Tell... Master Sandrock...
Hey! You've got to hang in there...!!
Maganac!! Hang in there, please hang in there!!
Please hang in there!! Maganac! Maganaaac!!!
Is this... what a Gundam does...!?
Team Trinity...!! They're an enemy we have to defeat...
Team Trinity... They're an enemy we can't allow to live...!
Team Trinity...!! I'll never forgive them!!
Team Trinity, huh... That's one bunch I'll never forgive...
Team Trinity!? Dunno who the hell they are, but I ain't lettin' 'em get away with this!!
Team Trinity... We can't just leave them be.
The enemy... didn't put up as much resistance as I expected.
Strange. The enemy's being way too quiet...
So this is the storehouse... Aren't there any enemies?
Something's off... Aren't there any enemies?
There don't seem to be any enemies...
But it's strangely quiet, and that bothers me...
That's weird. Aren't there any enemies?
All right, let's hurry up and find somethin' we can use!!
Looks like we could use it on the Ride Machine!
This cannon... We could probably use it to arm the Ride Machine.
Oh! This cannon looks like it'll come in handy.
This cannon... Could we use it to arm the Ride Machine...?

notes.note: 0241 #0.2-0.10 and #0.13-0.21 are party-leader variants with no or partial labels; voiced by register (#0.13/#0.21 rough, #0.14/#0.20 polite, #0.15-16 curt). #0.8 subject restored as "we" (the party grabbed the alloy).
Speaker "???" read as Deathscythe Hell arriving (labelled on the next row, #0.12); kept casual for Duo.
Labelled Deathscythe Hell; plain "Good work." after Birth's "Way to go!" (#0.22).

0243 #0.2-0.10, #0.14-0.22, #0.24-0.32, #0.36-0.42 are leader variants (only the first of each set labelled Mebius). Polite variants (#0.6, #0.10, #0.28, #0.32) given softer wording where the line allows; the -san on Maganac (#0.18, #0.22) dropped per project convention, so those read the same as the others.
Dying Maganac pilot; "a Gundam got us" follows story_021 (0205 #0.9). Source brackets Team Trinity; quotes dropped as in story_021-023.
Sandrock-sama rendered "Master Sandrock" (servant register, matching "Master Deathscythe Hell" in story_025). Line deliberately trails off.
"Shikkari shiro" to a dying man rendered "Hang in there!!" rather than story_021's "Pull yourself together!!"; suits a deathbed better.
Narration shaped like story_021 0205 #0.26 ("the Maganac's strength gave out"); ambiguous between collapsing and dying, kept so.
00 (Setsuna) questioning whether this is what a Gundam does (his Gundam ideal); kept literal.
"Ikashite oite wa ikenai aite" kept at full force: "an enemy we can't allow to live".

Hokanko = the Weapons Storehouse of Operation C (story_029, 0228 #0.62); rendered "storehouse" throughout. 0244 rows are leader variants, mostly in pairs; #0.1-0.2 labelled Zero, but #0.2 is calm and may be a shifted label; worded neutrally. #0.5 is a lone mission-report line (Heero/Setsuna style).
Source ends with a stray line break; dropped.
Item-get format copied from earlier slices (Obtained the "Rider Pass".).

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant blocks in 0241/0243/0244/0245 have partial labels; voiced by register. 0241 #0.11 ??? = Deathscythe Hell. "Storehouse" for hokanko (Operation C Weapons Storehouse) is not in glossary. No new character names.
